# Non-immune

## Read data

Read main table
```{r}
## Get 295 drug information
drug_info <- readRDS('/home/chenshuting/drug_toxicity/prior_knowledge/drug_info_df.rds')

# Drug-tissue-toxicity metric dataframe
drug_tissuetox_df <- readRDS(paste0(WORK_DIR,'Rdata/drug_tissuetox_df/drug_tissuetox_df.rds')) # Generated by 2.3_drug_tissue_list.R, converted by 1.summrize_result_drug_level.R
drug_tissuetox_df <- drug_tissuetox_df %>%
  mutate(
    drug_name = sub("^[^_]+_", "", drug_id_name)
  )

# Sample DSE information
sample_tox_df <- readRDS(paste0(WORK_DIR,'Rdata/sample_tox_df/sample_tox_df.rds'))
sample_tox_df <- sample_tox_df %>%
  mutate(
    drug_name = sub("^[^_]+_", "", drug_id_name)
  )

## Read sample information
sample_info_tissue <- read.csv(paste0(WORK_DIR,'Tables/sample_info_tissue_scPharm.csv'))
```

Split by tissue into list
```{r}
tissues <- unique(drug_tissuetox_df$tissue)

drug_tissuetox_list <- split(drug_tissuetox_df, drug_tissuetox_df$tissue)
sample_tox_list     <- split(sample_tox_df,     sample_tox_df$tissue)
sample_info_list    <- split(sample_info_tissue, sample_info_tissue$Tissue)

```


Top 5 drugs per tissue

```{r}
top5drug_list <- lapply(
  drug_tissuetox_list,
  function(df) {
    df %>%
  mutate(rra_log10 = -log10(scPharm_RRA_score)) %>%
  filter(is.finite(rra_log10)) %>%          # Prevent Inf / NA
  arrange(desc(rra_log10)) %>%
  distinct(drug_id_name, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%  # Keep only most toxic row per drug
  slice_head(n = 5) %>%
  pull(drug_id_name)
  }
)

top5drug_list

```


## Get pan-tissue drugs

```{r}
## Original list
lst <- top5drug_list

## ① Remove id_ prefix
lst_no_id <- lapply(lst, function(x) {
  sub("^[^_]+_", "", x)
})

## ② Count drug occurrences (across tissues)
drug_freq <- table(unlist(lst_no_id))

## ③ Find drugs appearing >1 times
shared_drugs <- names(drug_freq[drug_freq > 1])

## ④ Keep only shared drugs in each tissue
lst_filtered <- lapply(lst_no_id, function(x) {
  x[x %in% shared_drugs]
})

## ⑤ Remove empty tissues (no remaining drugs)
lst_filtered <- lst_filtered[sapply(lst_filtered, length) > 0]

lst_filtered
```

## F3A Upset plot




```{r,fig.width=8,fig.height=5}

p <- get_upset(lst_filtered, height = unit(8, "cm"), width = unit(15, "cm"), comb_col = "#373636")
p

pdf(paste0(WORK_DIR,"Figures/Figure3_pathway/A_upset.pdf"), width = 8,height = 5)
draw(p)
dev.off()

# Output drug names left to right
comb = make_comb_mat(lst_filtered)
comb_ordering = order(comb_size(comb), decreasing = TRUE)
ordered_comb_names = comb_name(comb)[comb_ordering]
intersection_drugs = lapply(ordered_comb_names, function(nm) {
  extract_comb(comb, nm)
})
names(intersection_drugs) = ordered_comb_names
intersection_drugs

# Top-5 epithelial cell susceptibility drugs shared across multi-tissues
```

## Pathway boxplot function definition

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

plot_drug_perturbation <- function(
    data,
    highlight_drugs,
    y_var           = "DSE",
    y_transform     = NULL,
    y_limits        = NULL,        # e.g. c(0, 0.4), NULL for auto range
    title           = "Drug-induced transcriptional perturbation across pathways",
    y_label         = "DSS",
    point_color     = "#E05A3A"
) {
  if (!is.null(y_transform)) {
    data <- data %>% mutate(.y_val = y_transform(.data[[y_var]]))
  } else {
    data <- data %>% mutate(.y_val = .data[[y_var]])
  }
  
  drug_median <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(pathway_name), pathway_name != "NA", !is.na(.y_val)) %>%
    group_by(drug_id_name, pathway_name, drug_name) %>%
    summarise(median_y = median(.y_val, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  
  pathway_order <- drug_median %>%
    group_by(pathway_name) %>%
    summarise(pathway_median = median(median_y, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    arrange(desc(pathway_median)) %>%
    pull(pathway_name)
  
  drug_median <- drug_median %>%
    mutate(pathway_name = factor(pathway_name, levels = pathway_order))
  
  if (is.list(highlight_drugs)) {
    highlight_drugs <- unique(unlist(highlight_drugs))
  }
  
  highlight_points <- drug_median %>%
    filter(drug_name %in% highlight_drugs) %>%
    mutate(pathway_name = factor(pathway_name, levels = pathway_order))
  
  n_pathways <- length(pathway_order)
  
  # Build y-axis scale
  if (!is.null(y_limits)) {
    y_scale <- scale_y_continuous(
      limits = y_limits,
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.03, 0.08)),
      oob    = scales::squish   # Squish out-of-range points to boundary
    )
  } else {
    y_scale <- scale_y_continuous(
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.03, 0.08))
    )
  }
  
  p <- ggplot(drug_median, aes(x = pathway_name, y = median_y)) +
    geom_boxplot(
      fill          = "white",
      color         = "black",
      outlier.shape = NA,
      width         = 0.55,
      linewidth     = 0.4
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data  = highlight_points,
      color = point_color,
      size  = 2,
      alpha = 0.9
    ) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data               = highlight_points,
      aes(label          = drug_name),
      size               = 2.8,
      color              = "black",
      fontface           = "plain",
      direction          = "y",
      hjust              = 0,
      nudge_x            = 0.3,
      box.padding        = 0.3,
      point.padding      = 0.2,
      segment.size       = 0.3,
      segment.color      = "grey60",
      max.overlaps       = Inf,
      min.segment.length = 0.1,
      xlim               = c(NA, n_pathways + 0.5)
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(expand = expansion(add = c(0.5, 3))) +
    y_scale +
    labs(x = "Pathway", y = y_label, title = title) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 40, hjust = 1, size = 9, color = "black"),
      axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 9, color = "black"),
      axis.title      = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.line       = element_line(linewidth = 0.4, color = "black"),
      axis.ticks      = element_line(linewidth = 0.3, color = "black"),
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.grid      = element_blank(),
      plot.margin     = margin(8, 80, 8, 8)
    )
  
  return(p)
}
```


## F3C Pathway boxplot

```{r,fig.width=8,fig.height=5}
# scPharm_dse_median calculated per drug-tissue, outer median per tissue
top10_drugs <- drug_tissuetox_df %>%
    filter(!is.na(pathway_name), pathway_name != "NA", !is.na(scPharm_dse_median)) %>%
    group_by(drug_id_name, pathway_name, drug_name) %>%
    summarise(median_y = median(scPharm_dse_median, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")  %>%
  slice_max(median_y, n = 10) %>%
  pull(drug_name)

top10_drugs

p <- plot_drug_perturbation(
  data        = drug_tissuetox_df,
  highlight_drugs = top10_drugs,
  y_limits = c(0,0.25),
  y_var       = "scPharm_dse_median",
  y_label     = "Median SCF",
  title       = "Non-immune cell susceptibility to drugs across pathways"
)
p +
  plot_annotation(
    tag_levels = list(c("C"))
  )
ggsave(paste0(WORK_DIR,"Figures/Figure3_pathway/C_pathway_nonimm.pdf"),width = 8,height = 5)

```

### SF3 Other tissues

```{r,fig.width=32,fig.height=20}

other_tissues <- setdiff(names(top5drug_list), c("Bowel", "Skin"))

plot_list <- lapply(other_tissues, function(tissue) {
  sample_tox_df_subset <- sample_tox_df[sample_tox_df$tissue == tissue,]
  
  top10_drugs <- sample_tox_df_subset %>%
    filter(!is.na(pathway_name), pathway_name != "NA", !is.na(DSE)) %>%
    group_by(drug_id_name, pathway_name, drug_name) %>%
    summarise(median_y = median(DSE, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    slice_max(median_y, n = 10) %>%
    pull(drug_name)
  
  p <- plot_drug_perturbation(
    data            = sample_tox_df_subset,
    highlight_drugs = top10_drugs,
    y_limits = c(0, 0.42),
    y_label = "DSS",
    title           = paste0(tissue, " epithelial cell susceptibility to drugs across pathways")
  )
  return(p)
})

final_plot <- wrap_plots(plot_list, ncol = 4) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")

ggsave(paste0(WORK_DIR, "Figures/supplementary_figures/A-P_nonimm_tissue.pdf"), 
       final_plot, width = 32, height = 20)

```



# Immune

## Read data
```{r}
## Get 295 drug information
drug_info <- readRDS('/home/chenshuting/drug_toxicity/prior_knowledge/drug_info_df.rds')

# Drug-tissue-toxicity metric dataframe
drug_tissuetox_df_imm <- readRDS(paste0(WORK_DIR,'Rdata/drug_tissuetox_df/drug_tissuetox_df_imm.rds'))
drug_tissuetox_df_imm <- drug_tissuetox_df_imm %>%
  mutate(
    drug_name = sub("^[^_]+_", "", drug_id_name)
  )
# Keep id for Selumetinib (appears twice in one tissue)
drug_tissuetox_df_imm$drug_name[drug_tissuetox_df_imm$drug_id_name=='1062_Selumetinib'] <- 'Selumetinib_1062'
drug_tissuetox_df_imm$drug_name[drug_tissuetox_df_imm$drug_id_name=='1736_Selumetinib'] <- 'Selumetinib_1736'

# Sample DSE information
sample_tox_df_imm <- readRDS(paste0(WORK_DIR,'Rdata/sample_tox_df/sample_tox_df_imm.rds'))
sample_tox_df_imm <- left_join(sample_tox_df_imm,drug_info[,c('drug_id_name','pathway_name')],by='drug_id_name')
sample_tox_df_imm <- sample_tox_df_imm %>%
  mutate(
    drug_name = sub("^[^_]+_", "", drug_id_name)
  )
# Keep id for Selumetinib (appears twice in one tissue)
sample_tox_df_imm$drug_name[sample_tox_df_imm$drug_id_name=='1062_Selumetinib'] <- 'Selumetinib_1062'
sample_tox_df_imm$drug_name[sample_tox_df_imm$drug_id_name=='1736_Selumetinib'] <- 'Selumetinib_1736'

## Read sample information
sample_info_imm <- read.csv(paste0(WORK_DIR,'Tables/sample_info_imm_scPharm.csv')) 

```

Split by tissue into list
```{r}
tissues <- unique(drug_tissuetox_df_imm$tissue)

drug_tissuetox_list <- split(drug_tissuetox_df_imm, drug_tissuetox_df_imm$tissue)
sample_tox_list     <- split(sample_tox_df_imm,     sample_tox_df_imm$tissue)
sample_info_list    <- split(sample_info_imm, sample_info_imm$Tissue)

```


Top 5 drugs per tissue

```{r}

  distinct(drug_id_name, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%  # Keep only most toxic row per drug
  slice_head(n = 5) %>%

  }
)
```
